observation.command:
cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && COOKIE=UIH234dcbjn0934723dwmZSIZL2342423KUOWidsqw6123e
echo "### A: /app WITH cookie"
curl -s -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$COOKIE" "http://localhost:5195/app" | grep -c "Bovis Bohrs"
echo "### B: / WITH cookie"
curl -s -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$COOKIE" "http://localhost:5195/" | grep -c "Bovis Bohrs"
echo "### C: /app NO cookie"
curl -s "http://localhost:5195/app" | grep -c "Bovis Bohrs"
echo "### D: / NO cookie"
curl -s "http://localhost:5195/" | grep -c "Bovis Bohrs"
echo "### E: /app?x=1 WITH cookie"
curl -s -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$COOKIE" "http://localhost:5195/app?x=1" | grep -c "Bovis Bohrs"
echo "### F: // WITH cookie"
curl -s -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$COOKIE" "http://localhost:5195//app" | grep -c "Bovis Bohrs"
